solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: People following match will understand the situation

definitions.meaning: spectators watching a game keep track of the running tally of goals or points
to be fully aware of how things stand

explanation.surface: Fans at a game will grasp what is going on.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom: being aware of the facts of a situation, like a fan who keeps track of the tally.

clue.text: Violent sort, no good, starts to lambast you in forceful manner

indicators.note: violent suggests the letters are thrown about and rearranged
starts to means the opening letters of the following words are taken

explanation.surface: Describing a thuggish, worthless type who lays into the reader with force.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Violent' looks like an adjective for 'sort' but signals that SORT is shuffled into STRO; 'starts to' takes the first letters of 'lambast you'.
explanation.definitionFit: An adverb pair: acting with force is acting powerfully, the same manner.

clue.text: Reveal house in South West

indicators.note: in means the house abbreviation is placed within the compass letters

parts.note: SW is the abbreviation for south-west

explanation.surface: An estate agent unveils a property in the south-west of England.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym as verbs: to expose something to view is to display it.

clue.text: Shape of old boy, not short

parts.note: OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil
the opposite of short is long

explanation.surface: Asks for the figure of a former pupil who is not small.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a rectangle longer than it is wide is one kind of geometric figure.

clue.text: Our disturbed character not finishing gambling game

indicators.note: disturbed means the three letters of the word are knocked into a new order
not finishing means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a character can be a letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone troubled who cannot stop playing at the casino wheel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbed' rearranges OUR to ROU; 'not finishing' cuts the final R from LETTER, leaving LETTE.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a casino pastime where a ball on a spinning wheel decides who wins bets.

clue.text: Record made by some band is covered

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A band's album that includes cover versions of other artists' songs.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition took in 'made', but 'made by' is only the link joining the definition to the hidden-word wordplay; 'Record' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a vinyl album is a flat platter of recorded music.

clue.text: Nick cannot change, not entirely

indicators.note: not entirely says only part of the following words' letters are used, a run inside them

explanation.surface: Someone named Nick who is set in his ways and only partly able to change.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nick' reads as a man's name, but it is the definition, a small cut.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a nick is a small cut or groove in an edge.

clue.text: Express dislike of things worn — children's footwear

parts.note: to boo is to jeer in disapproval
neckties are items worn

explanation.surface: Someone grumbling about clothes, especially the shoes children wear.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: soft knitted shoes for babies and infants.

clue.text: Likely acts at unconventional US location

indicators.note: unconventional says the letters are put in a non-standard arrangement

explanation.surface: Odd performances are probably to be found somewhere in America.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the capital of Utah is a place in the United States.

clue.text: Book posing question of doctor's identity?

definitions.meaning: a reference volume of short biographies of notable people
asking who the TV time-traveller called Doctor Who really is

explanation.surface: A volume that asks the identity of a doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: Doctor Who is the long-running British TV science-fiction series; asking who the Doctor is gives the question in the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Named example: a famous annual directory of prominent people's biographies.

clue.text: Like some unsugared drink in pub

definitions.meaning: a diet drink is low in calories, written in short form
a neighbourhood bar, the one people regularly visit

explanation.surface: Ordering a diet soft drink in a bar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lo-cal', short for low-calorie, describes sugar-free drinks; 'local' is British slang for the nearby pub you frequent.
explanation.definitionFit: British usage: a person's nearest regular bar is called by this informal name.

clue.text: Maybe star's most memorable moment

definitions.meaning: a star is an example of a light high in the sky
the best or outstanding part of an event

explanation.surface: A celebrity's finest hour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'star' seems to be a celebrity, but read literally it is a lamp up in the heavens; the 's is 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the standout part of an occasion, the bit everyone remembers best.

clue.text: Prescribed in odd law needing reform

indicators.note: needing reform says the letters must be reshaped into a new order

explanation.surface: A legal provision found within an eccentric statute that should be changed.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: rules that are stipulated or established are said to be set out formally.

clue.text: Friend knocking drink back

indicators.note: back says the word for drink is turned to run the other way

parts.note: to lap is to drink as a cat does

explanation.surface: A mate downing a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocking ... back' looks like a single phrase for drinking, but only 'back' does the work.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an informal word for a mate or companion.

clue.text: Maybe banana worker in flat territory

indicators.note: in means the worker is placed inside the territory

parts.note: a plain is a flat expanse of land
an ant is the standard crossword worker insect

explanation.surface: A farmhand working on bananas in lowland country.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a starchy cooking fruit of the banana family, with 'Maybe' marking that it is one kind.

clue.text: Throw lacking confidence?

definitions.meaning: a toss, as at a coconut stall

explanation.surface: A nervous throw.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a fairground toss of a ball, and timid or reserved by nature.

clue.text: Uninformed as one suffering power cut?

definitions.meaning: a household with no electricity has no light

explanation.surface: Not knowing what's going on, like someone in a blackout.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: being unaware is likened to sitting with no light to see by.

clue.text: Type of clothes that would be quaint on daughter and son

parts.note: twee means quaint or overly dainty

explanation.surface: Old-fashioned outfits that look charming on one's children.
explanation.walkthrough: TWEE is British for affectedly quaint or cutesy.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: rough woollen country suits, a classic style of garment.

clue.text: Love to cast an eye over nymph

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, which looks like O
to read a text is to look it over

explanation.surface: A fondness for glancing at a mythical maiden.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: in Greek myth a mountain spirit is one kind of nymph.

clue.text: You once reflected about Doctor of Divinity: a twister

indicators.note: about means the reversed old pronoun goes around the degree letters
reflected means the old pronoun is read backwards as in a mirror

parts.note: ye is the archaic form of you
DD is the abbreviation for this theology degree

explanation.surface: Addressing a clergyman of old who turns out to be a swindler.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reflected' turns YE into EY, which goes 'about' DD.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a whirlpool or swirl of water or air is something that spins round.

clue.text: Unreliable man, bad type at heart

indicators.note: at heart means the villain is put in the middle of the name

parts.note: Eric is a man's name
a rat is a contemptible person

explanation.surface: A man who can't be trusted, a villain deep down.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: inconsistent and unpredictable, so not dependable.

clue.text: About to grab work to become secure

indicators.note: to grab means the word for about takes hold of the work inside it

parts.note: re means about or concerning
OP is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Someone about to snatch a job for financial security.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb synonym: to tie with cord is to fasten or make fast.

clue.text: Paid for the last thing, then was in debt

parts.note: the end is the final part
owed means had a debt

explanation.surface: Someone who finally paid, having been in debt.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to provide funds for a post or institution, as for a university chair.

clue.text: Put a coat on?

parts.note: reads as dressing in an overcoat, but means applying a layer of colour to a surface

explanation.definitionFit: Decorating sense: applying a layer of emulsion or gloss to walls is called a coat.
